description: Outputs from the local phase-picking adapters.

files.probabilities.npz: Model probability array and sample rate
files.run_result.json: Model identity, effective configuration, input/output shapes and runtime summary

phase_labels: Labels are reported from the bundled model metadata; for PhaseNet the order is N, P, S.
note: Thresholding, phase-time extraction, association and quality control remain workflow-level decisions.
failure: The adapter exits non-zero and records status=failed when possible. Existing output directories are not reused unless --overwrite is supplied.
